notes.note: Reviewed the SessionTurnBoundaryAuthority composition and caller path. Boundary writes/listing now run through sqlite-session-turn-boundary and Monument; sealed-task admission stays in the transaction, storage errors retain host classification, and EventStore owns the outer append commit. Physical terminal reconciliation, liveness and opaque capabilities remain host-owned. Production peer-visibility and rollback tests now call the real authority; frozen pre-migration SQL is independent of the package. No provider, native or publication qualification claimed.

Reviewed the disposition table and EventStore composition after extracting boundary writes/listing to Monument. Added the bounded boundary row and retained owner/terminal reconciliation explicitly. RecoveryLedger, credential handles, native/voice owners and retained facades are unchanged; this is no claim that phase2 or other primitives are complete.

Reviewed the bound-host boundary guide against production composition, fixed terminal callbacks and nested executeSync. Updated the former inert-contract statement: production boundary writes/listing now consume the binding. Storage errors/sealed-task admission and physical event-terminal reconciliation remain Station concerns. Existing exported conformance and timestamp/sequence limits remain accurate. Local scripted evidence is distinct from provider and publication proof.

Reviewed terminal facts and extraction boundary. Production writes/listing now use the bound existing table on EventStore connection, without shadow terminal facts. Host classification/admission and physical terminal SQL reconciliation remain; the read-only event-authoritative projection is pending. Kernel pure decisions and public entrypoints are unchanged.
